Hi Amy — great to hear from you, and glad the demo was useful. Host answers inline and attaching our intake checklist.

1) Billing path: We support two common flows for GCP Marketplace listings: 1) Marketplace metered billing (charges appear on customer GCP invoice) and 2) Direct billing (Nimbus pays Redwood invoice). For most customers who want simple procurement, Marketplace metered billing simplifies procurement approvals. If your team needs reseller invoicing or special tax handling, we can route to our finance ops.

2) Checklist: see attached procurement_onboard_checklist.xlsx — it includes required security artifacts (SOC 2 Type II report, data flow diagram), SKU mapping template, and the contract redline window.

3) Contacts:
- Legal review: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com)
- Billing & finance: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com)
- Partner/Marketplace ops: Soojin Lee (soojin_lee@redwood.com)

4) Proposed 3-week cadence (suggested):
Week 0 (Kickoff): intake form + required docs uploaded to shared Drive
Week 1: finance & SKU mapping meeting; legal initial redline
Week 2: listing prep & staging; marketplace tests; DocuSign routing
Week 3: final signoff and go-live plan (soft launch)

Suggested kickoff agenda (30 min): intro, intake review, billing path decision, legal timeline, next steps. I can run the kickoff on Tuesday at 10am PT. Does that work?

Attaching: procurement_onboard_checklist.xlsx (stub), redwood_listing_terms_v1.docx (stub)

Best,

Amy / Soojin — quick legal note before kickoff:

- We prefer Marketplace metered billing for standard SaaS SKUs (simplifies tax and reseller flows). If Nimbus needs a Net-30 direct invoice, that'll require a procurement addendum and finance approval (we'll need Nimbus credit references).
- Contract redlines: our typical turnaround is 3 business days for initial review; complex commercial changes (reps/warranties, indemnity) may extend that.
- DocuSign flow: please pre-populate signers and the legal billing contact on the last page so we can route to Marissa for countersign.

If Nimbus prefers, we can include a short SOW addendum describing usage tiers for marketplace metering (helps finance map estimated spend to SKUs).

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
